vision.name: Righteous Assault
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 2.
([Trait:Saiyan] only. Heroes only.)
[Attack] Physical attack.
Focused. Raise your anger 1. You are considered to have no cards in your hand for your effects until the end of your next action this combat. [Warning]: Rejuvenate up to 2 "Heroes only" and/or [Warning] cards from your discard pile.
DAMAGE: 5 stages.
HIT: Banish an opponent's Setup, Drill, or Ally.
